/about.title: 1 About/
copy: GOPHER AI is a standalone phone assistant you pay for. You talk to a number. It turns the talk into an order, fetches, and brings the answer back to the same thread.
The name is the point. Old Gopher was a menu, a selector, a fetch. No infinite scroll. No chat sludge. A modern prompt sits on that contract.

/how.title: 2 How it works/
steps: You send an order — voice, SMS, or the prompt.
GOPHER AI files it as a selector: fetch, watch, draft, remind.
Plugins you connect do the work.
The result comes back to the same conversation.

/caps.title: 3 Capabilities/
caps: Voice and SMS in. A reply out.
Orders, not chat.
Numbered menus + a modern ask box.
FETCH, an original 8-bit hole.
A log of what was asked and what came back.
/caps.note: Not a general chatbot. Not a free public menu.

/privacy.title: 4 Privacy
/privacy.copy: We keep your waitlist email now; later, your number and order logs to do the job. Login on this page stays on this device. We don’t sell any of it.

/play.copy: FETCH is an original 8-bit burrow on this site. One tap, one tile. Free demo. Not the paid phone assistant.
steps: Move one tile at a time — arrows, WASD, or the pad.
Press 9 to login on this device.
/play.note: Type howto in the prompt for this page. Press 5 to play.

/terms.title: Terms/
copy: This site is a public hole for GOPHER AI: a directory, a waitlist, and FETCH.
Waitlist: you give an email. We keep it to tell you when the paid phone assistant is ready. No other contract yet.
No SLA. The GitHub Pages hole can go down. The local python server is for a machine you run yourself.
FETCH is a free demo in the browser. Scores on Pages stay on the device unless you run the local server.
Login on this page is a device hole, not a cloud account, not a paid seat.
/terms.note: Paid phone service terms will ship with billing. Not before.

/faq.title: FAQ/
copy: What is GOPHER AI? A paid phone assistant named after the 1991 Gopher protocol. You send an order. It fetches. This site is the public hole, not the number yet.
How do I play FETCH? Press 5 or open #/fetch. START. One tap, one tile. Arrows, WASD, or the pad. Collect blink packets. Walls bump. Orange sludge costs a life.
Is login cloud? No. A name and passphrase hashed with PBKDF2 in localStorage on this device. Not a GOPHER AI account.
Is FETCH live prices? No. FETCH is the 8-bit burrow. Live tickers are a different fetch: type fetch btc (or ETH, SOL, XRP) in the prompt.
GitHub Pages vs local? Pages hosts the static hole (directory, FETCH, device login, client waitlist). python3 server.py on your machine adds /api/waitlist, /api/score, /api/scores, /api/ask.
How do I waitlist? Selector 6, type waitlist, or use the email form on the site. On Pages it stores on this device if the API is missing. Local python keeps the server list.

/security.title: Security/
copy: Login is PBKDF2 (SHA-256, 120000 iterations) in localStorage. Not cloud. The passphrase never leaves this device.
No API keys in the page. No wallet keys. No phone number stored here.
FETCH scores post only to local /api/score when you run python3 server.py. GitHub Pages has no score API.
Waitlist email goes to /api/waitlist locally, or stays in this browser on Pages.
/security.note: This is a static hole plus an optional local server. Treat it that way.

/keys.title: 9 Keys/
caps: 1–9 — selectors in the current directory (home: 1 Docs/, 5 FETCH, 6 waitlist, 8 Games/, 9 User/)
/ — focus the prompt
? — prompt + a short help line
esc or 0 — home
5 — play FETCH (from home)
arrows / WASD / pad — move in FETCH (one tile)
START / MUTE — on the FETCH panel
type an alias (play, faq, waitlist) or an order (fetch btc)

/es.title: ES/
copy: GOPHER AI es un asistente de teléfono de pago, llamado así por el protocolo Gopher de 1991. Hablas a un número. Convierte el pedido, busca, y responde en el mismo hilo.

Cómo jugar FETCH: pulsa 5 o abre #/fetch. START. Un toque, un tile. Flechas, WASD o el pad. Recoge los paquetes que parpadean. Los muros golpean. El lodo naranja quita una vida. MUTE. 9 para entrar en este aparato.

Instalar: en el teléfono, Añadir a pantalla de inicio. iPhone (Safari): Compartir, luego Añadir a pantalla de inicio. Android Chrome: Instalar app, o el menú y Añadir a pantalla de inicio. Es un marcador con icono, no el asistente de pago.
/es.note: Stub i18n. Un solo hueco. El resto del directorio sigue en inglés.
